title: [Master] -Revert Changes- 'Greater Than' Withholding Tax Calculation Rule is not applied correctly in Withholding Tax Posting Setup.
summary: Reverts the earlier change from PR 9515 to how the 'Greater Than' withholding tax calculation rule is applied. The journal subscriber, withholding tax management and purchase subscriber codeunits return to their previous logic, and the tests added by that PR are removed.
key_points: Undoes the changes made in PR 9515
Withholding Tax Jnl Subscriber, Withholding Tax Mgmt. and Wthldg Tax Purch. Subscribers codeunits revert to their earlier logic
Test cases added by the original PR are removed
Affects withholding tax handling on purchase transactions
